---
title: "Code along crash course: test-driven development"
---

Prerequisite:

1.  Participants have been introduced to test-driven development.
2.  Participants have forked the `segue` R package repository and created an R studio project form it. See [setup instructions](https://erc-segue.nl/tdd-r-pkg/setup.html).

In groups of 2, including a domain expert and a participant with (some) development experience:

1.  Open the test file `tests/testthat/test-segue.R` and write your tests following the template given there. Start with the statements and then write the test code for 1-3 tests.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Synthetic data for testing
synth_data <- sf::st_sf(
  unit_id = paste0("cell_", 1:10),
  group_a = c(20, 10, 0, 30, 20, 10, 0, 30, 20, 10),
  group_b = c(30, 20, 10, 10, 30, 20, 10, 10, 30, 20),
  group_c = c(50, 20, 30, 10, 50, 20, 30, 10, 50, 20),
  geometry = sf::st_make_grid(
    sf::st_as_sfc(sf::st_bbox(
      c(xmin = 92000, ymin = 435000,
        xmax = 93000, ymax = 437500),
      crs = sf::st_crs(28992) # CRS of the Netherlands
    )),
    cellsize = 500
  )
)

# Example tests:
# Test 1: the shares are correct and the geometry is preserved
testthat::test_that("group shares are calculated correctly", {
  result <- calculate_group_shares(synth_data)
  
  # Shares correctly calculated
  testthat::expect_equal(result$share_a, c(0.2, 0.2, 0, 0.6, 0.2, 0.2, 0, 0.6, 0.2, 0.2))
  testthat::expect_equal(result$share_b, c(0.3, 0.4, 0.25, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.25, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4))
  testthat::expect_equal(result$share_c, c(0.5, 0.4, 0.75, 0.2, 0.5, 0.4, 0.75, 0.2, 0.5, 0.4))
  
  # Class and geometry preserved
  testthat::expect_s3_class(result, "sf")
  testthat::expect_equal(sf::st_geometry(result), sf::st_geometry(synth_data))
  
})

# Test 2: function rejects invalid group counts (negative values)
testthat::test_that("invalid group counts are rejected", {
  
  # Copy data to modify it with negative values
  negative_data <- synth_data
  negative_data$group_a[1] <- -1
  
  # Expected error from the function: function should flag negative values when calculating shares
  testthat::expect_error(
    calculate_group_shares(negative_data),
    "non-negative"
  )
  
  # Copy data to modify it with missing values
  missing_data <- synth_data
  missing_data$group_a[1] <- NA
  
  # Expected error from the function: function should flag missing values when calculating shares
  testthat::expect_error(
    calculate_group_shares(missing_data),
    "missing"
  )
  
})

# Make as many copies of the test block as you need
test_that("YOUR STATEMENT HERE", {
	# Test to be added here
})
```

2.  Run the following code to confirm that the tests fail. This is normal.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
devtools::test()
```

3 Open the module file `R/segue.R` and try to implement the function(s) that will help you pass the tests you wrote. Run the tests every time you want to check if the test passes.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
calculate_group_shares <- function(data) {
  
  counts <- sf::st_drop_geometry(data)[
    c("group_a", "group_b", "group_c")
  ]

  total <- rowSums(counts)
  
  data$share_a <- data$group_a / total
  data$share_b <- data$group_b / total
  data$share_c <- data$group_c / total
  
  data
}
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
devtools::test()
```

> Test 2 should fail because it is testing a specific behaviour: function should return error if negative or missing values, but currently the function is not providing any error messages in those cases. Go back to the module file `R/segue.R` and modify the function.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
calculate_group_shares <- function(data) {
  
  counts <- sf::st_drop_geometry(data)[
    c("group_a", "group_b", "group_c")
  ]
  
  # Expected errors
  if (anyNA(counts) | any(as.matrix(counts) < 0)) {
   stop(
     "Group counts must be non-missing and non-negative.",
     call. = FALSE
   )
  }
  
  total <- rowSums(counts)
  
  data$share_a <- data$group_a / total
  data$share_b <- data$group_b / total
  data$share_c <- data$group_c / total
  
  data
}  
```
